layers.name: Browser interface
layers.description: Input controls, export previews, and static pages.

layers.name: Schedule handling
layers.description: Paste recognition, table parsing, merging, and week resolution.

layers.name: Calendar export
layers.description: iCalendar and Google Calendar output, styling, and OAuth.

layers.name: Build and delivery
layers.description: Project configuration, licenses, and GitHub Pages workflow.

tour.title: Paste and detect
tour.description: The home route accepts several blocks and lets the user override detection for each paste.

tour.title: Separate classes and exams
tour.description: Modern myBK classes resolve against ISO weeks. Exams keep their date and duration from the portal.

tour.title: Preview in local time
tour.description: The weekly grid and exam cards render separately. Google Calendar colors can follow the course code.

tour.title: Export a calendar
tour.description: The iCalendar formatter produces a local file. Google imports request access scoped to app-created calendars.

tour.title: Verify and deploy
tour.description: Tests run before a static build is sent to GitHub Pages.
